title: Shopify webhook HMAC check always fails because the framework parsed the JSON body first
symptoms: Every webhook gets a 401 from your own handler
Verification passes only for tiny payloads or never at all
cause: The signature is computed over the exact raw bytes Shopify sent. Middleware like express.json() parses and drops them, and re-serializing the object changes spacing and key order.
fix: Read the raw body for the webhook route only, compute HMAC SHA256 with the app client secret, and compare with a timing-safe check. After rotating the secret, expect the old one in signatures for up to an hour.
affected: Shopify HTTPS webhook delivery, all API versions; Express, Next.js route handlers, any framework with body parsing
